items.author: Musk
items.text: Elon Musk Thanked Micron Twice on Tesla's Earnings Call -- Here's Why That's Great News
items.summary_cn: Musk在Tesla财报会上两次点名感谢Micron(MU)，等于公开背书MU为AI/HBM内存关键供应商，对存储链是强信号。

items.author: Trump
items.text: NVIDIA: Building in America, for America: https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/made-in-usa/
items.summary_cn: Trump转发英伟达'美国制造'宣传页面，背书NVDA在美本土生产AI芯片的制造业回流叙事。

items.author: Trump
items.text: NVIDIA and Partners Build in America, for America: https://blogs.nvidia.com/blog/nvidia-and-partners-build-in-america-for-america/
items.summary_cn: Trump转发英伟达官方博客：'NVIDIA and Partners Build in America, for America'，持续背书AI芯片美国制造。

items.author: Trump
items.text: Tariffs pull, USMCA pushes: Toyota to Texas: https://thehill.com/opinion/white-house/5965989-toyota-texas-tacoma-tariffs-impact/
items.summary_cn: 分析指关税拉动、USMCA推动丰田将Tacoma生产从墨西哥迁回德州，验证Trump关税政策对车企供应链的实际影响。

items.author: Musk
items.text: Reality Bites Elon Musk and His Tesla, SpaceX Believers
items.summary_cn: 媒体看空Musk旗下Tesla与SpaceX投资人信念，间接提示SPCX/SPCH/RKLX等SpaceX敞口持仓存在叙事降温风险。

items.author: Musk
items.text: As Elon Musk Promises The Future, Tesla Stock Slides Into The Past
items.summary_cn: 报道标题批评Musk一边'承诺未来'，Tesla股价却滑向过去，对TSLA情绪偏负面。

items.author: Musk
items.text: Elon Musk said money doesn't matter. Then he rolled out X Money and admitted he's a 'former trillionaire'
items.summary_cn: Musk推出X Money支付服务并自嘲'前万亿富翁'，为X的金融/支付业务站台，间接利好加密支付生态(含CRCL稳定币赛道)。

items.author: Trump
items.text: Trump Rallies Around 'Trump Accounts' During Ga. Speech: https://www.newsmax.com/newsfront/donald-trump-georgia-rally-investment-accounts/2026/07/22/id/1263753/
items.summary_cn: Trump在佐治亚演讲中推广'Trump Accounts'(婴幼儿投资账户)，涉及未来美国储蓄/投资政策方向。

items.author: Trump
items.summary_cn: Trump转发CNBC对Invest America创始人Brad Gerstner的专访，议题涉及美国资本市场/投资政策。
